# history commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `clear` | Clear all query history for the current environment |
| `delete` | Delete a query history entry |
| `execute` | Re-execute a query from history |
| `get` | Get a specific query history entry |
| `list` | List recent query history entries |
